snippet.title: Paperlands - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Paperlands is a cozy 2D puzzle adventure set in a handcrafted papercraft world where nothing works until it has color.

Unlock new colors, use them to solve puzzles and help the people of Paperlands to bring their home to life!

Paperlands is available now on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3196370/Paperlands/
